description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This listing is for the Rear Grab Handles with Installation Screws.
These handles go directly behind both seats to assist passenger stability.
These Handles and are a must if you ever carry rear passengers.
I promise they will thank you for it later on.
Color: Black
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 2 – Black Grab Handles
Qty 4 – Attachment Screws
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
